resolved_findings.issue: Unknown IPC state returned immediately from wait and triggered a busy polling loop while another request remained active.
resolved_findings.resolution: Condition wait after broken state; notify only on actual events; bounded poll-count and retained late usage regression.

resolved_findings.issue: Temporary NOT_ACCEPTED handoff backpressure became a query failure.
resolved_findings.resolution: Retain bounded unsent call and retry only before acceptance; actual IPC input-byte and command-slot probes.

resolved_findings.issue: Full control queue dropped cancellation intent.
resolved_findings.resolution: Separate cancel intent from successful abort enqueue and retry until queued; retain actual receipts and usage.

resolved_findings.issue: Next legitimate Core session failed while previous asynchronous ack had not run.
resolved_findings.resolution: Wait for prior receipt acknowledgement within deadline; production Core plus real CPU IPC delayed-ack test.

resolved_findings.issue: Late old aborts exhausted early-cancel capacity before next session first prepared call.
resolved_findings.resolution: Separate cancellation epoch, purge previous early set on higher epoch, reject stale absent keys, preserve cancels on held work and idempotent early cancels.
